findings.summary: The freshness check pipes find -print0 into xargs -0 ls -t | head -1. On a large dist xargs batches the list, so head -1 returns the newest file of the first batch only, giving a false stale or false fresh. Same as the existing _repo_build_fresh, not a regression, but a false stale now triggers a build.
